data.one_liner: Flutter Calendar widget with multiple views and appointment management
data.what_it_does: Provides a calendar UI with day, week, month, timeline, and schedule views. Supports appointments, recurrence, drag‑and‑drop, time zones, resources, and customizations like blackout dates and working days.
use_when: Need a full-featured calendar UI in a Flutter app
Require recurring appointments or resource scheduling
Want drag‑and‑drop or resize of events
avoid_when: You only need a simple date picker or list of events
You are building a lightweight app and want to avoid a commercial license
strengths: Rich set of built‑in views and customization options
Supports time zones and recurrence out of the box
weaknesses: Requires a Syncfusion commercial or community license
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, and provide Syncfusion license key via SyncfusionLicense.registerLicense()
